ajilenakh-nut.name: Ajilenakh Nut
ajilenakh-nut.description: A fruit that grows on evergreen trees within desert oases. The flesh under the tough skin is thick, sweet, and delicious, making it an important food source amongst the desert peoples.

almond.name: Almond
almond.description: A seed with a peculiar fragrance that gives food a refreshing taste.

bacon.name: Bacon
bacon.description: Smoked strips of pork. With just enough fat, but not too greasy.Mmmmm... Bacon.Meat must be processed first to be made into Bacon.

bamboo-shoot.name: Bamboo Shoot
bamboo-shoot.description: A fresh young bamboo shoot, straight out of the ground. It is a delicious cooking ingredient with an exotic aroma, found exclusively in bamboo-growing regions.

berry.name: Berry
berry.description: Small brightly-colored fruit. They can be found everywhere, and the taste of them wipes the fatigue of a long journey away.

bird-egg.name: Bird Egg
bird-egg.description: An incredibly versatile ingredient that can supply all of your daily protein needs.
sources: Vendor: Draff, Head of Hunters at Springvale

butter.name: Butter
butter.description: An extract from milk. With the appropriate application, it can bring rich aromas to even the most basic ingredients.

cabbage.name: Cabbage
cabbage.description: A layered, leafy vegetable. Said to have originally been an ornamental plant, it certainly looks great in the pot.

calla-lily.name: Calla Lily
calla-lily.description: A flower that grows near water sources. When cooked the petals have a chunky texture, yet are sweet and a little bitter.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.description: A healthy and nutritious vegetable that is crunchy and sweet to the taste. Easy to grow and harvest.

cheese.name: Cheese
cheese.description: Made from fermented milk. With high energy and limitless possibilities, it's used in a wide range of dishes.Milk must be processed first to be made into Cheese.

chilled-meat.name: Chilled Meat
chilled-meat.description: Rare, fresh meat.This species of boar is recorded to have gone extinct several hundred years ago and has been preserved by the extreme temperatures on Dragonspine. For the gourmets of Teyvat, this is an ingredient of unspeakable sacrosanctness.

chenyu-adeptea.name: Chenyu Adeptea
chenyu-adeptea.description: Tea grown in warm, moist areas in Chenyu Vale. After millennia of careful cultivation, the tea today emits a rich fragrance that can be savored from several streets away.
sources: Found in the wild in Chenyu Vale

coffee-beans.name: Coffee Beans
coffee-beans.description: A common fruit in Teyvat with a special aroma. It can be used to make beverages after being ground.

crab.name: Crab
crab.description: A shelled creature that lives near the ocean. Its flaky, delicious meat can easily be made into tasty dishes.
sources: Found near lakes, river banks, and beaches

crab-roe.name: Crab Roe
crab-roe.description: A delicacy specific to female crabs. A rare and prized ingredient that isn't quite to everyone's taste.

cream.name: Cream
cream.description: A dairy product made from milk. An essential ingredient in making pastries.

fermented-juice.name: Fermented Juice
fermented-juice.description: A fermented juice with a unique fruity scent. It is often used as a marinade.

fish.name: Fish
fish.description: A fresh fillet of fish. Handled correctly it can make a rich dish.

flour.name: Flour
flour.description: A powder ground from wheat. No matter what it goes into it brings a sense of satisfaction to the diner. Wheat must be processed first to be made into Flour.

fowl.name: Fowl
fowl.description: A fresh bird. Handled correctly it can make a hearty meal.
sources: Vendor: Draff, Head of Hunters at Springvale

glabrous-beans.name: Glabrous Beans
glabrous-beans.description: A common legume in Teyvat with a light aroma. It can be prepared in a variety of ways, and is thus widely accepted by people all over the world.

grainfruit.name: Grainfruit
grainfruit.description: This plant is named after the giant grains that grow along the cob.

ham.name: Ham
ham.description: Smoked leg meat. Even the thinnest slice is packed full of flavor.Meat must be processed first to be made into Ham.

harra-fruit.name: Harra Fruit
harra-fruit.description: Growing in the hot humid rainforest, it is a fruit with a special spicy aroma. When ground to powder, spices can be made from it. It is the most valued spice plant in Sumeru.

jam.name: Jam
jam.description: A puree made from fruit and sugar. Even a little bit can easily wake up drowsy taste buds. Apples and Berries must be processed first to be made into Jam.

jueyun-chili.name: Jueyun Chili
jueyun-chili.description: A spicy plant native to Liyue.Merely smelling it makes one hot and thirsty.

lakkaberry.name: Lakkaberry
lakkaberry.description: A fruit as white as pearl that tastes refreshingly sweet.

lavender-melon.name: Lavender Melon
lavender-melon.description: A brightly-colored fruit. The flesh within transforms into food with a unique mouthfeel when cooked.
sources: Found in the wild in Inazuma

lotus-head.name: Lotus Head
lotus-head.description: An aquatic plant native to Liyue that grows and blooms in pairs. One is fragrant, and the other bitter. It's said to make a good herbal medicine.
sources: Found near lakes and river banks

matsutake.name: Matsutake
matsutake.description: A rare fungus that generally grows on or near pine trees. Its delicate aroma gives away its location.

marcotte.name: Marcotte
marcotte.description: A pink flower with a pearl-like luster and rich scent profile. It is one of the most important ingredients in a perfumer's arsenal.

milk.name: Milk
milk.description: Sweet and fragrant cow's milk. Don't waste a single drop, not even that one rolling down your chin.

midsommar-berry.name: Midsommar Berry
midsommar-berry.description: A fruit that grows in the warmer parts of Nod-Krai. It is beloved by animals emerging from winter and hungry children alike.

mint.name: Mint
mint.description: A refreshingly cool ingredient. The cool, fresh flavor can cut through the heat of many dishes.

mushroom.name: Mushroom
mushroom.description: Hardy common fungi. Can grow anywhere with the right amount of shade and moisture.

onion.name: Onion
onion.description: A spherical vegetable. As vengeance for cutting it, it will make you cry, no matter how brave you are.

pepper.name: Pepper
pepper.description: Peppery. Cuts through oily flavors and excites the taste buds. Goes best on meat.

pinecone.name: Pinecone
pinecone.description: Filled with oil-rich seeds. Certainly won't be growing into a tree from inside a squirrel's stomach.

potato.name: Potato
potato.description: A chunky vegetable. A gift from the earth that you never tire of with its multitude of cooking methods.

qingxin.name: Qingxin
qingxin.description: A translucent white flower that only grows on the highest stone peaks. It eschews the warmth and moisture of the plains to gaze out afar from the solitary mountaintops.
sources: Found in the heights of stone forests

radish.name: Radish
radish.description: Rich in fiber and nutrients. Easy to grow and harvest.

raw-meat.name: Raw Meat
raw-meat.description: A fresh chunk of meat. Handled properly it can be used to make delicious food.

rice.name: Rice
rice.description: A grain crop commonly found in Teyvat. People of all walks of life enjoy its distinct grainy texture. As the saying goes, "The same kind of rice can feed one hundred kinds of people."

rye.name: Rye
rye.description: The gray-brown ears are a gift from the earth. Their richness can only be brought out by grounding and roasting.

rye-flour.name: Rye Flour
rye-flour.description: A coarse, dark powder produced from grinding rye. Food made with it has a unique texture and a somewhat sour flavor.

salt.name: Salt
salt.description: A savory seasoning. A precise but adequate amount will elevate the quality of the cuisine.

sausage.name: Sausage
sausage.description: Finely minced meat wrapped in a skin. A staple of every meat lover's daily diet.Meat must be processed first to be made into Sausages.

seagrass.name: Seagrass
seagrass.description: A plant that grows in shallow seas. It adds a unique flavor to dishes.
sources: Found in the wild in Inazuma

shrimp-meat.name: Shrimp Meat
shrimp-meat.description: A whole piece of deep sea shrimp meat, full of nutrients and bursting with delicious flavor.

small-lamp-grass.name: Small Lamp Grass
small-lamp-grass.description: A wild grass that emits light at night. Used in cooking to enhance other flavors.
sources: Found in the wild at night

smoked-fowl.name: Smoked Fowl
smoked-fowl.description: Fowl that has been smoked. The firm texture gives new taste to dishes.Fowl must be processed first to be made into Smoked Fowl.

snapdragon.name: Snapdragon
snapdragon.description: Can be eaten once cooked. As a spice it can bring wonderful flavor to dishes.

sugar.name: Sugar
sugar.description: A seasoning derived from Sweet Flowers. Has the power to give both energy and happiness.Can be purchased from the merchants in the city, or made with Sweet Flowers.

sumeru-rose.name: Sumeru Rose
sumeru-rose.description: Bright and beautiful, these pure purple flowers give off a pleasant fragrance that will give any passerby pause. While some like to call this type of "rambler rose," its relative lack of multiple flowers means that it falls under a different floral classification.

sweet-flower.name: Sweet Flower
sweet-flower.description: Particularly fragrant flowers. They can be found easily, even in the dark. Just follow the scent.

tidalga.name: Tidalga
tidalga.description: An algae floating with the tides that sustains itself by feeding on substances produced by other plants. Though often mistaken for zooplankton, based on its nature, Tidalga is actually a type of phytoplankton.

tofu.name: Tofu
tofu.description: Freshly made bean product that has a silky-smooth tender texture.

tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.description: A bright red ingredient that gives a tangy kick. Yes, the 'fruit or vegetable' debate is still going…

violetgrass.name: Violetgrass
violetgrass.description: A small flower with strong vitality. It was said its downward-blooming flower keeps its fragrance from dissipating.

windrest-flower.name: Windrest Flower
windrest-flower.description: An exquisite flower that remains delicate and fresh, found primarily in the northern part of Mondstadt. Its fragrance is clear and enduring, making it one of the primary ingredients used in perfumery.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.description: Golden sun-kissed tassels. Needs to be ground down to flour for further use.

zaytun-peach.name: Zaytun Peach
zaytun-peach.description: The fruit of a forest shrub. Its flesh is firm and sweet. It is said to have a calming effect on the mind.
